test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Dietary fibres help in regulating glucose levels in the body.
Dietary fibres help in preventing heart disease.
Dietary fibres help in relieving constipation.
Dietary fibres help in absorption of trace metals.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Dietary fibres help in absorption of trace metals**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence of the last paragraph says "***The dietary fibres may have some adverse effects on nutrition by binding some trace metals** like calcium, magnesium, phosphorus, zinc and others and therefore **preventing their proper absorption***''. (अंतिम पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है, dietary fibres कैल्शियम, मैग्नीशियम, फास्फोरस, जस्ता और अन्य जैसे कुछ ट्रेस धातुओं को बांधकर पोषण पर कुछ प्रतिकूल प्रभाव डाल सकते हैं और इसलिए उनके उचित अवशोषण को रोकते हैं)
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that the statement in the fourth option is NOT true. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से हम कह सकते हैं कि चौथे विकल्प में कथन सत्य नहीं है)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 4.

5f:Tcdb,

The correct answer is '**Importance of dietary fibres**.'
